scripts.prebuild:
test -f src/assets/mermaid-catalog/en/manifest.json && test -f src/assets/mermaid-catalog/ja/manifest.json || { printf '
The mermaid catalog under src/assets/mermaid-catalog/ is generated, not committed, and is missing or incomplete.
Render it with konoma first:

    npm run gen:catalog

(that runs cargo, so it is a few minutes on a cold build; the Docs workflow does the same before building the site.)

' >&2; exit 1; }
